name: xray-cloud
description: Manage Xray Cloud tests, test sets, plans, executions and runs through a zero-install Python MCP server.

settings.name: Xray client ID
settings.description: Xray Cloud API key client ID.

settings.name: Xray client secret
settings.description: Xray Cloud API key client secret.

settings.name: Xray region
settings.description: Xray Cloud region: global, eu or au.

settings.name: Settings file
settings.description: Optional explicit path to the Xray settings file (YAML or JSON) listing projects and fields.

settings.name: Jira site URL
settings.description: Optional. Jira works only with the site URL, the email of the account the token belongs to, and the token, all three; leave all empty to use the JIRA_* environment variables. Example: https://yourcompany.atlassian.net

settings.name: Jira email
settings.description: Optional. Email of the Jira account the API token belongs to; needed together with the site URL and token.

settings.name: Jira API token
settings.description: Optional. Jira API token; works only together with the email of its Jira account and the site URL (all three needed).

settings.name: Read-only mode
settings.description: Set to true to make every write tool refuse to run.

settings.name: Tool groups
settings.description: Optional. Comma-separated tool groups; leave empty for all tools.
